name: Bloodmage: Dark Curse raises weapon and spell critical strike chance (#1996)
contract: Dark Curse 704649 (3%) and 560252 (6%): "Increases critical strike chance by $s1%." Each has a single effect, aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, MiscValue 0 and an empty EffectSpellClassMask, handled by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:355), which for a player runs both UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras and UpdateAllSpellCritChances - exactly the unqualified "critical strike chance" the tooltip promises. This core ignores aura 290's misc value and class mask (.agents/docs/systems/ascension-spell-parity.md:333), which does not bite here because both records carry zero for both. No source or SQL change is involved. The scenario primes the crit fields before taking its baselines: melee_crit_chance reads the raw PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE field (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:657), which only Player::UpdateCritPercentage rewrites and which that function clamps at zero (StatSystem.cpp:815). Run 20260920T155102294488353Z recorded that field as 0 on a fresh level-80 character and as 7.2525 one step later, once applying an aura 290 had forced a recalculation - i.e. the login value was a stale clamped 0 and the 7.2525 is 4.2525 of agility plus the aura's 3. Applying and removing Crit Test Buff 503747 (a single aura 290 effect, DurationIndex 21 = permanent) runs that same recalculation twice and leaves the field at the real unbuffed value, so the relative_to baselines measure the aura and nothing else.

steps.label: Force one crit recalculation: the login value of PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE is stale
Drop the primer again so the baselines are the unbuffed, recalculated values
Rank 1 adds 3 points of Shadow spell critical strike
Rank 1 adds 3 points of melee critical strike
Rank 2 adds 6 points of Shadow spell critical strike
Rank 2 adds 6 points of melee critical strike
